cards.q: State the core advertising rules (7.1-7.2): misleading communications, paying for recommendations, and specialist claims.
cards.qZh: 请陈述广告核心规则（7.1-7.2）：误导性宣传、付费推荐与专家宣称。
cards.a: 7.1: no FALSE OR MISLEADING communication about the lawyer or services — includes literally true but misleading statements, unjustified expectations, unsubstantiated comparisons. 7.2: may advertise through any media; every ad must include the name and contact information of a lawyer or firm; no paying for recommendations EXCEPT reasonable advertising costs, qualified lawyer-referral services/legal service plans, purchase of a practice (1.17), nominal thank-you gifts, and nonexclusive reciprocal referral arrangements disclosed to the client. Specialist claims require certification by an ABA-accredited/state-approved organization, named in the ad.
cards.aZh: 7.1：不得就律师或服务作虚假或误导性宣传——包括字面真实但误导的陈述、制造不合理期待、无依据的比较。7.2：可通过任何媒介宣传；每则广告须载明律师或律所的名称与联系方式；不得为获得推荐付费，例外：合理广告费、合格的律师转介服务/法律服务计划、依1.17收购业务、象征性谢礼、向客户披露的非排他互惠转介。宣称'认证专家'须经ABA认可或州批准的机构认证并在广告中列明机构名称。
cards.explainZh: '误导'比'虚假'宽：'从未输过官司'（真话）也可能误导。胜诉率、客户见证要带免责说明。加州对应：7.1-7.2+商业与职业法典§6157起（广告不得含保证、'无效果不收费'须说清费用负担）。加州'认证专家'须经州律师协会法律专业化委员会（或其认可机构）认证。
cards.caNote: CA: certified specialist claims require State Bar Board of Legal Specialization (or approved entity) certification; B&P §§6157-6158 add content rules for ads (no guarantees/warranties; dramatizations and 'no fee' claims regulated).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州：'认证专家'须经州律师协会法律专业化委员会（或认可机构）认证；§§6157-6158另有广告内容规则（禁止保证效果；情景再现与'不收费'宣传受规制）。

cards.topicZh: 律所、无照执业、广告与公共服务
cards.q: Which live, person-to-person solicitation of legal work for a fee is PERMITTED under Rule 7.3?
cards.qZh: 根据规则7.3，下列哪种以营利为目的的实时当面招揽是允许的？
choices: Visiting hospitalized accident victims with retainer agreements
Cold-calling homeowners after a wildfire
Offering services at a networking event to a former client whose deal the lawyer handled last year
Live-chatting unsolicited with strangers on social media about their injury claims
cards.explain: Live person-to-person solicitation for pecuniary gain is banned EXCEPT with other lawyers, family members, close personal relationships, prior business/professional relationships (including former clients), and persons who routinely use legal services of that kind for business. Even exempt contacts become improper if the target expressed a desire not to be solicited or the approach involves coercion, duress, or harassment.
cards.explainZh: 招揽禁令只打'实时人对人+图财'组合：写信、群发邮件、一般广告不算(但加州要求定向招揽信函标注'广告')。豁免五类：律师、家人、密友、既往业务关系（含前客户）、常规采购该类法律服务的商业主体。红线：对方明示拒绝后继续=违规；胁迫骚扰=违规。无偿公益招揽（如ACLU式）受宪法保护不在禁令内。
cards.caNote: CA 7.3 same structure; California adds prohibited-situations rules (accident scene, impaired judgment, coercion) and an 'Advertisement' labeling duty — see the companion CA card.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州7.3结构相同，另有禁止情形（事故现场、判断力受损、胁迫）与'广告'标注义务——见加州配套卡。

cards.topicZh: 律所、无照执业、广告与公共服务
cards.q: What California-specific solicitation rules apply: prohibited situations, labeling, and runners?
cards.qZh: 加州特有的招揽规则有哪些：禁止情形、标注义务与'拉客人员'？
cards.a: Under CA Rule 7.3(b), a lawyer may not solicit when the lawyer knows the person is in such a physical, emotional, or mental state that reasonable judgment about hiring counsel is unlikely (the classic accident-scene / en-route-to-hospital scenarios), or when the contact involves coercion, duress, or harassment. Solicitation communications must be plainly labeled 'ADVERTISEMENT' unless sent to family, prior/existing clients, or close acquaintances. B&P §§6151-6152 criminalize RUNNERS AND CAPPERS — paid agents who procure clients.
cards.aZh: 依加州规则7.3(b)，下列招揽被禁止：律师明知对方处于无法就聘请律师作合理判断的身体/情绪/精神状态（典型场景：事故现场、送医途中）；或接触方式含胁迫、强迫或骚扰。招揽性函件须显著标注'广告'字样（家人、现有/既往客户、密友除外）。商业与职业法典§§6151-6152将'拉客人员'（受雇招揽客户的中间人）入罪。
cards.explainZh: '救护车追逐'情形在2018年前的旧规则1-400下表述为'推定违规'，现行规则7.3(b)改为直接禁止——结论相同，答题用现行禁止表述。标注义务防止招揽信伪装成私人信件。runners/cappers是加州刑事罪名（医院勾结、警局线人卖案源等）。中国《律师执业管理办法》同样禁止不正当手段承揽业务，可对照记忆。
cards.caNote: The prohibited-situations rule, the 'Advertisement' label, and the criminal runner/capper statutes are California overlays with no ABA Model Rule counterpart.
cards.caNoteZh: 上述禁止情形、'广告'标注及拉客人员刑事条款均为加州特有，ABA示范规则无对应规定。

cards.topicZh: 律所、无照执业、广告与公共服务
cards.q: Summarize pro bono (6.1), mandatory appointments (6.2), and law-related services (5.7).
cards.qZh: 请概述公益服务（6.1）、法院指派（6.2）与法律相关服务（5.7）。
cards.a: 6.1: ASPIRATIONAL — every lawyer should render at least 50 hours of pro bono yearly, primarily free services to persons of limited means (not enforceable by discipline). 6.2: do not seek to AVOID court appointments except for GOOD CAUSE — representation likely to violate the Rules or other law, unreasonable financial burden, or a client/cause so repugnant as to likely impair the relationship or representation. 5.7: the Rules apply to LAW-RELATED services (e.g., consulting, title work) unless provided distinctly and the lawyer takes reasonable measures ensuring the recipient knows no client-lawyer protections attach.
cards.aZh: 6.1：倡导性——每位律师每年宜提供至少50小时公益法律服务，主要面向经济困难者（不因未达标受处分）。6.2：非有正当理由不得规避法院指派——正当理由限于：代理可能违反规则或法律；造成不合理经济负担；客户或事业令律师深恶痛绝以致可能损害委托关系或代理质量。5.7：'法律相关服务'（咨询、产权查验等）亦适用规则，除非与法律服务明确区分且律师采取合理措施使接受者知晓不享有律师-客户保护。
cards.explainZh: 6.1考点：aspirational（应当而非必须）；'厌恶'要达到损害代理的程度才是拒派理由——单纯不喜欢被告人不行。5.7考点：附属业务不隔离=全套规则（含保密、冲突）跟着走。加州无强制公益时数，B&P §6073倡导性表述类似。
cards.caNote: California has no 50-hour rule text; pro bono is aspirational via B&P §6073 (and a provisional-licensee/admissions context), and CA has no adopted counterpart to Model Rule 5.7 — analogous results reached through case law on when lawyer duties attach.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州无50小时条文；公益义务经§6073倡导性表述；加州未采纳示范规则5.7的对应条款——类似结论由判例就'律师义务何时附着'达成。
